name: clockyn-kb
description: Customer knowledge base of the Clockyn app: the retrieval source for the future Live Chat assistant (AWS Bedrock). Markdown in git, generated FAQ files, checks and an S3 export.

scripts.faq:from-db: python scripts/export-faq-from-db.py --out rows.json && node scripts/faq-to-kb.js --rows rows.json
scripts.build: npm run faq:generate && npm run index
scripts.check: node scripts/check-kb.js && node scripts/faq-to-kb.js --check && node scripts/build-index.js --check
